title: VisionFrame
description: A single frame of visual input on the data plane. PROVISIONAL — nothing produces these yet. Defined now so the data plane is not accidentally designed around audio alone, which is the mistake that would make adding vision a redesign rather than an adapter (ADR-0024).

consumers: (none yet — vision_service, brain_gateway when vision capability is enabled)

compatibility.notes: PROVISIONAL and may change freely until promoted. NO PROTOBUF MIRROR EXISTS YET — unlike AudioFrame, this has no counterpart in common.proto, because writing wire format for a subsystem with no producer is speculative work. The .proto is added at the same time the first producer is. Promotion to stable is gated at G10, and ADR-0024 is explicit that Phase 10 is not committed.

payload_policy.rule: Same as AudioFrame: image bytes NEVER cross the control plane. A brain request referencing an image uses ContentBlock.image_ref (a URI or content-addressed handle), never inline base64.
payload_policy.why: Beyond the size argument, an inline base64 image in a prompt log is a privacy problem — frames of someone's room should not be recoverable from a debug trace.

seq.description: Monotonic. Gaps are legitimate — dropping frames under backpressure is required, blocking is forbidden.

timestamp_ns.description: Relative to stream start. When audio and vision are fused later, both being stream-relative is what makes alignment possible.

keyframe.description: False for delta-encoded frames. A consumer joining mid-stream must wait for a keyframe.

payload_ref.description: URI or content-addressed handle. THE PREFERRED FORM — a reference, not bytes, so the frame can be passed through the control plane's neighbourhood without carrying an image.

source.description: robot_sensor reserved for ADR-0024. Listed now so the enum does not need a MAJOR bump the day a camera is mounted on something that moves.

privacy.description: Vision is more invasive than audio and the contract says so explicitly rather than leaving it to policy documents.

consent_recorded.description: MUST be true before any frame is persisted or leaves the Host Runtime.

retention.description: Default ephemeral: process and discard. Anything else is a deliberate decision.
